verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a live, public REST API documentation page for YubiEnterprise (console.yubico.com/apidocs/), but nothing shows it is interactive or offers runnable examples. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs on docs.yubico.com all returned 404, and the docs are described as human-oriented HTML only. A static API reference is an adjacent feature, not the interactive, runnable reference this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
